breakdown.description: The torque-induced arc load is replaced by a fixed global-x traction instead of a tangential traction field
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt by stating 'Apply this traction as the fixed Cartesian vector T = (M / (2 * pi * r), 0) on the loaded arc boundary segment.' The ground truth requires the traction to be applied in the local tangent direction of the loaded arc, not as a fixed global Cartesian vector. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
